items.text: When their `wgmma` on the stage has completed, the consumers arrive on "empty"
The consumer warpgroups wait on "full", then issue `wgmma` on the stage
The TMA unit signals the stage's "full" barrier when all the bytes have arrived
The producer issues TMA loads of the next A and B tiles into the stage
The producer waits until the stage's "empty" barrier says consumers are done with it
